title: personal.json read_states
description: The read states of the person, one per thread the person has read in (read_states): the highest read position and when it last changed. Channels and threads appear only by ID; unread counters are never stored, so they are not exported.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel of the thread.

last_read_seq.description: Highest read position (thread_seq) in the thread.

updated_by_device_id.description: ID of the own device of the last change; absent when unknown.
